tool.name: nf-core blat
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ in=$query if $unzip then gunzip -cdf $query > ${prefix}.fasta in=${prefix}.fasta fi
blat \\ $args \\ $subject \\ \$in \\ ${prefix}.psl
if $unzip then rm ${prefix}.fasta fi
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": blat: \$(echo \$(blat 2>&1) | sed 's/^.*BLAT v. //; s/ fast.*\$//') END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Queries a sequence subject
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: blat Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/blat ]]>
